purpose: Independent Director source verification for P11 decision review; no host qualification or product execution.

sources.observed_support: Linux origin calculation attempts /proc/self/exe; fallback handling exists. The proposed finite profile must refuse fallback rather than assume all launch paths behave identically.

Upstream patch discussion explicitly distinguishes direct executable origin from explicit-loader/ldd origin and proposes canonicalization changes. The post is not proof of deployment on a selected host.

The manual distinguishes RPATH from RUNPATH search inheritance and documents ORIGIN expansion and hardware-capability search paths. A new origin rule cannot safely be implemented as string substitution alone.

limitations: No actual host loader version, variant list, directory inventory, launch identity or H0 condition is established by these sources.
An independently bounded nonselecting added path is a design restriction; it is not a general dynamic-loader implementation.
